name: chipmate
displayName: ChipMate: AI Coding Agent, Copilot, and Autocomplete
description: Open Source AI coding agent that generates code from natural language, automates tasks, and runs terminal commands. Features inline autocomplete, browser automation, automated refactoring, and custom modes for planning, coding, and debugging. Supports 500+ AI models including Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, Grok, GPT, Codex and GLM.

chipmate.v2.language.description: Override the UI language for ChipMate (e.g. en, de, ja). Defaults to Simplified Chinese; choose Auto to use VS Code's display language.

chipmate.v2.languageCommitMessage.description: Language used for AI-generated commit messages. Choose 'sync' to follow the ChipMate UI language, or select a specific language.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.enabled.description: Enable ChipMate plugin update checks from the unified ChipMate Server.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.autoDownload.description: Automatically download and verify compatible ChipMate plugin updates. Installing requires one explicit Install and Reload Window action.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.autoInstall.deprecationMessage: Use chipmate.v2.updateCheck.autoDownload. Updates are installed only when you choose Install and Reload Window.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.baseUrl.deprecationMessage: Use chipmate.v2.chipmateServer.baseUrl to configure the unified ChipMate Server.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.checkOnStartup.description: Check for ChipMate updates after extension startup.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.intervalHours.description: Minimum hours between automatic ChipMate update checks and repeated automatic warning notifications.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the ChipMate update manifest and VSIX connection/response headers.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.downloadTimeoutM.description: Total timeout in milliseconds for downloading a complete ChipMate VSIX update.

chipmate.v2.updateCheck.maxDownloadBytes.description: Maximum downloaded VSIX size in bytes for ChipMate update checks.

chipmate.v2.documents.artifacts.root.description: Workspace-relative root directory used by VS Code document artifact commands. Document generation tools currently default to .chipmate-v2/artifacts unless configured separately.

chipmate.v2.documents.wordRender.remoteE.description: Deprecated compatibility setting for the Word renderer endpoint. Configure ChipMate Server in the extension settings instead.

chipmate.v2.documents.mermaidRender.remo.description: Deprecated compatibility setting for the Mermaid renderer endpoint. Configure ChipMate Server in the extension settings instead.

chipmate.v2.documents.wordRender.autoVer.description: Opt-in flag for explicit document workflows that choose to render Word documents after generation or edits. It is disabled by default and does not affect ordinary QA.

chipmate.v2.marketplace.baseUrl.deprecationMessage: Use chipmate.v2.chipmateServer.baseUrl to configure the unified ChipMate Server.

chipmate.v2.indexing.openaiCompatible.ba.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint for codebase RAG indexing. Internal/offline packages may set this at packaging time; API keys are never defaulted.

chipmate.v2.patentRadar.scheduleDays.description: VS Code 打开工作区时补跑 Patent Radar 的最小间隔天数。

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.model.description: Model to use for inline autocomplete suggestions. If unset, the recommended default is used.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.maxPromptT.description: Continue-style prompt token budget for qwen-direct autocomplete context.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.prefixPerc.description: Continue-style fraction of prompt budget reserved for prefix context.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.maxSuffixP.description: Continue-style maximum fraction of prompt budget reserved for suffix context.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.modelTimeo.description: Continue autocomplete model timeout setting retained for qwen-direct helper parity diagnostics.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.cache.enab.description: Enable Continue-style in-memory qwen-direct autocomplete cache reuse.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.prefixChar.description: Legacy compatibility limit retained for qwen-direct autocomplete settings; Continue-style token budget controls default prompt pruning.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.suffixChar.description: Legacy compatibility limit retained for qwen-direct autocomplete settings; Continue-style token budget controls default prompt pruning.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.multifileC.description: Enable Continue-style lightweight multi-file context for FIM autocomplete.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.contextLen.description: Explicit qwen-direct autocomplete model context length. Zero means unknown and disables snippet prompt injection.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.context.re.description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete recently edited range context collection.
Inject selected recently edited snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.

Maximum lines retained per recently edited range for qwen-direct autocomplete.

Per-file read timeout in milliseconds for qwen-direct recently opened autocomplete context.

Inject selected import definition snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.

Maximum import definition file-info entries retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.context.ro.description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete root path context collection.
Inject selected root path snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.

Maximum root path snippet entries retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.logLevel.description: Diagnostic log level for qwen-direct autocomplete.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.logPromptP.description: Include short redacted prompt previews in qwen-direct debug diagnostics.

chipmate.v2.autocomplete.qwen.logComplet.description: Include short redacted completion previews in qwen-direct debug diagnostics.

chipmate.v2.speechToText.model.description: Model to use for experimental speech-to-text voice input. Requires ChipMate Gateway.

chipmate.v2.claudeCodeCompat.description: Load CLAUDE.md instructions and skills from your Claude Code configuration directory into ChipMate sessions. Enable this if you want ChipMate to use your Claude Code instructions and skills.

chipmate.v2.extraCaCerts.description: Absolute path to a PEM file containing extra CA certificates to trust when the ChipMate backend makes HTTPS requests (sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS on the CLI process). Use this if you're behind a corporate proxy that performs SSL inspection. Leave empty to rely on the OS trust store.

chipmate.v2.autoApprove.enabled.description: Start ChipMate with the main auto-approve toggle enabled. When enabled, permission prompts are approved automatically.

chipmate.v2.maxCost.description: Show a non-blocking alert when a session exceeds this USD amount. Use whole dollars; set to 0 to disable.

chipmate.v2.browserAutomation.enabled.description: Enable browser automation powered by Playwright. When enabled, the AI agent can interact with web pages in a visible Chrome window.

chipmate.v2.browserAutomation.useSystemC.description: Use your system's installed Chrome browser instead of downloading a separate Chromium instance.

chipmate.v2.browserAutomation.headless.description: Run browser automation in headless mode (no visible window). When disabled, you can watch the agent interact with the browser.

scripts.compile: bun run prepare:cli-binary -- --force && bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.watch: bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run --parallel watch:esbuild watch:tsc
scripts.package: bun run prepare:cli-binary && bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: bun run compile-tests && bun run compile && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run check-types && bun run check-types:webview
